evals.name: classify_case: VIP executes VIP-only row
evals.description: When account_type is VIP and precondition is '是会员', the case should be classified as 'execute'.
evals.notes: Rule correctly implemented: VIP account triggers VIP-only cases.

evals.name: classify_case: non-VIP skips VIP-only row
evals.description: When account_type is non-VIP and precondition is '是会员', the case should be classified as 'skip'.

evals.name: classify_case: VIP skips non-VIP-only row
evals.description: When account_type is VIP and precondition is '不是会员', the case should be classified as 'skip'.

evals.name: classify_case: empty precondition + VIP → execute
evals.description: Generic cases (empty precondition) execute for VIP (default test account).

evals.name: classify_case: empty precondition + non-VIP → skip
evals.description: Generic cases skip for non-VIP — by design since VIP is the default comprehensive test account.
evals.notes: Intentional design choice: non-VIP tests only cover non-VIP-specific cases.

evals.name: classify_case: state_dependent rows (生成中, 生成完成, 生成后)
evals.description: Preconditions like '生成中', '生成完成', '生成后' should return 'state_dependent' regardless of account type.

evals.name: classify_case: unknown precondition → execute (fallback)
evals.description: Unrecognized preconditions should fall back to 'execute' as a safe default.
evals.notes: Safe default: when in doubt, execute rather than silently skip.

evals.name: hdc_input_text: shell metacharacter escaping
evals.description: The input text function should escape shell-special characters to prevent injection.

test.concern: Only escapes " and $. Missing: backtick (`), pipe (|), semicolon (;), newline, $(cmd) substitution.

evals.notes: SECURITY: The escape logic only handles '"' and '$', but hdc shell passes text through a shell. Semicolons, backticks, pipes, and $(...) can execute arbitrary commands. Fix: use subprocess with list args or shlex.quote().

evals.name: hdc_screenshot: hardcoded remote filename conflict
evals.description: Multiple concurrent test runs would overwrite each other's screenshots because the remote path is hardcoded as '/data/local/tmp/_test_screenshot.png'.

test.concern: Hardcoded remote filename causes race condition if two tests run simultaneously on the same device.

evals.notes: Minor: concurrent runs on the same device are rare. Acceptable for single-runner use case. Would need PID/timestamp in filename for multi-runner support.

evals.name: retry_action: MAX_ATTEMPTS=3, delay=10s
evals.description: The retry mechanism is reasonable: 3 attempts with 10s delay for critical operations.

test.concern: Hardcoded delay values may not suit all scenarios (e.g., fast LAN vs slow 4G).

evals.notes: 3-attempt retry with 10s delay is a sensible default. Worth making configurable for different network conditions.

evals.name: Excel result columns: VIP/non-VIP shared F/G/H
evals.description: VIP and non-VIP tests share the same F/G/H columns. Each test only writes to its own rows. The existing-value check prevents overwrites.

test.concern: If a test crashes mid-write, F column could have partial data that the next test interprets as 'already filled'.

evals.notes: Design is sound. The crash scenario is mitigated by: (a) writing F column last in the write sequence, (b) the skip-on-existing-value check uses F column presence as a gate.

evals.name: State dependency chain: blocking cascade
evals.description: If a key node fails (e.g., outline generation), all dependent rows should be bulk-marked as 'blocked', not tested individually.

test.expected_behavior: On key node failure, immediately mark all dependent rows as '阻塞: <reason>' without attempting individual execution.

evals.notes: This is a well-designed optimization. Without it, 100+ dependent rows would each timeout individually, wasting significant time.

evals.name: Screenshot embedding: path string prohibition
evals.description: G column MUST contain embedded image objects, never file path strings.
evals.notes: Skill correctly emphasizes this with multiple warnings and code examples. The embed_screenshot() helper enforces it.

evals.name: PIL.Image compatibility: LANCZOS vs ANTIALIAS
evals.description: The skill notes the Pillow version compatibility issue but the code still uses LANCZOS without a try/except fallback.

test.concern: Will crash on older Pillow (<10.0.0). The note says to fall back to ANTIALIAS but the code doesn't implement the fallback.

evals.notes: The note documents the issue but the code doesn't handle it. Should add: try LANCZOS, except AttributeError fallback to ANTIALIAS/BILINEAR.

evals.name: LIVE: Markdown parse + classify (Phase 0)
evals.description: Real test on TestCase.md with 25 cases. VIP account classification. 14 execute / 4 skip / 7 state_dependent.
evals.notes: Classification correct. Module breakdown matches expected: 首页 4 (3 exec/1 skip), 大纲生成 8 (3 exec/5 state), 模板选择 5 (3 exec/2 skip), PPT生成 5 (2 exec/1 skip/2 state), 设置 3 (3 exec).

evals.name: LIVE: Markdown writeback + batch blocking (Phase 2)
evals.description: Executed 6 cases (5 pass, 1 BUG), batch-blocked 4 '生成完成' cases due to simulated outline failure.
evals.notes: - [ ] → - [x] correctly. Emoji (✅/❌/🚫) + result + timestamp appended. Batch blocking correctly skipped already-written rows.

evals.name: LIVE: hdc UI dump + screenshot (Phase 1)
evals.description: Tested on hdc 3.2.0c with OpenCalculator app. dumpLayout outputs JSON (not XML). uitest screenCap works for PNG screenshots.
evals.notes: CRITICAL: SKILL.md originally assumed XML output from 'uitest dump'. hdc 3.x uses 'uitest dumpLayout' which outputs JSON. FIXED: added detect_hdc_api() + dual-format parse_ui_tree(). Also snapshot_display requires .jpeg suffix, uitest screenCap is preferred.

evals.name: LIVE: hdc click + coordinate accuracy (Phase 2)
evals.description: Clicked calculator buttons 1, +, 2, = at dumpLayout-reported coordinates. Result showed '1+2' in display but = didn't compute correctly.
evals.notes: Coordinate offset suspected between dumpLayout and uiInput click coordinate systems. May need calibration: check status bar / nav bar height compensation. Added to hdc 踩坑记录.
